tools.name: rqml_validate
tools.description: Document validation: check an RQML document against the XSD and its referential integrity. Not requirements validation in the ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148 sense, which a person records by approving a requirement.

path.description: Filesystem path of the .rqml document; read without modification (REQ-MCP-PATH-INPUT).

file.description: A file or directory whose governing spec to resolve by nearest-wins discovery (alternative to xml/path; REQ-CORE-SPEC-DISCOVERY).

tools.name: rqml_status
tools.description: Summarize an RQML document: requirement count, trace coverage, and dangling references.

path.description: Filesystem path of the .rqml document; read without modification (REQ-MCP-PATH-INPUT).

file.description: A file or directory whose governing spec to resolve by nearest-wins discovery (alternative to xml/path; REQ-CORE-SPEC-DISCOVERY).

tools.name: rqml_check
tools.description: Run the deterministic check — document validation, trace coverage (goal → requirement → implementation → verification), and drift on linked files — and return a pass/fail verdict.

path.description: Filesystem path of the .rqml document; read without modification (REQ-MCP-PATH-INPUT).

file.description: A file or directory whose governing spec to resolve by nearest-wins discovery (alternative to xml/path; REQ-CORE-SPEC-DISCOVERY).

baseDir.description: Directory code links resolve against. Defaults to the spec's directory when path is given, else the working directory.

tools.name: rqml_trace
tools.description: Resolve the trace graph and report dangling local references.

path.description: Filesystem path of the .rqml document; read without modification (REQ-MCP-PATH-INPUT).

file.description: A file or directory whose governing spec to resolve by nearest-wins discovery (alternative to xml/path; REQ-CORE-SPEC-DISCOVERY).

tools.name: rqml_discover
tools.description: Discover the RQML specs a repository holds (nearest-wins, REQ-CORE-SPEC-DISCOVERY): enumerate every governing spec beneath root (and the ambiguous directories), plus — when file is given — the single spec governing that path. Read-only.

root.description: Directory to enumerate governing specs beneath, and the upper boundary for resolving file.

file.description: Optional file or directory whose governing spec to resolve, bounded by root.

tools.name: rqml_show
tools.description: Extract one artifact by id — statement, acceptance criteria, and trace neighborhood — as structured data plus markdown.

path.description: Filesystem path of the .rqml document; read without modification (REQ-MCP-PATH-INPUT).

file.description: A file or directory whose governing spec to resolve by nearest-wins discovery (alternative to xml/path; REQ-CORE-SPEC-DISCOVERY).

tools.name: rqml_impact
tools.description: What is affected, transitively, if this artifact changes? Trace-graph traversal in both directions.

path.description: Filesystem path of the .rqml document; read without modification (REQ-MCP-PATH-INPUT).

file.description: A file or directory whose governing spec to resolve by nearest-wins discovery (alternative to xml/path; REQ-CORE-SPEC-DISCOVERY).

tools.name: rqml_matrix
tools.description: Traceability matrix: one row per requirement with status, upstream goals, implementing code, verifying tests, and coverage warnings — as structured data plus a markdown table. Optional status/type/warning filters (comma-separated).

path.description: Filesystem path of the .rqml document; read without modification (REQ-MCP-PATH-INPUT).

status.description: Comma-separated requirement statuses to include (e.g. draft,review).

type.description: Comma-separated requirement types to include (e.g. FR,NFR).

warning.description: Comma-separated warning codes to filter to: unverified, unimplemented, orphan, premature, broken-trace.

tools.name: rqml_overview
tools.description: A readable projection of the spec — the whole document, or a subset scoped by section title or element id — as a structured outline plus markdown.

path.description: Filesystem path of the .rqml document; read without modification (REQ-MCP-PATH-INPUT).

section.description: Comma-separated section titles to keep (e.g. Goals,Requirements).

id.description: Comma-separated element ids to keep (a package id keeps the whole package).

tools.name: rqml_approve
tools.description: Transition a requirement's lifecycle status (default approved). Writes the spec FILE textually, re-validating first — requires path (explicit caller intent per REQ-MCP-READONLY).

path.description: Filesystem path of the .rqml document; read without modification (REQ-MCP-PATH-INPUT).

tools.name: rqml_gate
tools.description: Approval-before-implementation verdict: implements edges whose requirement is not approved, optionally scoped to changed paths. blocked=true means an external control loop should block the edit.

path.description: Filesystem path of the .rqml document; read without modification (REQ-MCP-PATH-INPUT).

changed.description: Comma-separated changed paths to scope the verdict to.

tools.name: rqml_skeleton
tools.description: Generate a schema-valid RQML snippet for any authorable element — requirements and traces, but equally goals, scenarios, glossary terms, business rules, entities and the rest. Returns the snippet plus the section it belongs under. Reach for this instead of hand-writing markup: req, edge, testCase, stateMachine, goal, qgoal, obstacle, goalLink, scenario, misuseCase, edgeCase, term, actor, stakeholder, constraint, policy, decision, risk, entity, rule.

kind.description: The element to generate a snippet for.

tools.name: rqml_link
tools.description: Record or maintain a trace edge in the spec FILE and its drift baseline. Modes: append (default) adds a new edge of any trace type between two endpoints (each a declared artifact id or an external URI; implements/verifiedBy are auto-oriented, other types are recorded exactly from → to); update repoints an existing implements/verifiedBy edge's external locator; refresh re-records the drift baseline for one edge without touching the spec. New edges are stamped status=draft and createdBy unless overridden. Writes to disk — requires path (explicit caller intent per REQ-MCP-READONLY).

path.description: Filesystem path of the .rqml document; read without modification (REQ-MCP-PATH-INPUT).

baseDir.description: Directory code links resolve against. Defaults to the spec's directory when path is given, else the working directory.

mode.description: append (default): add a new edge. update: replace the external locator of an existing implements/verifiedBy edge. refresh: re-record the baseline entry for edgeId only.

from.description: Source endpoint: a declared artifact id or an external locator URI. Required in append mode (or pass artifactId/uri).

to.description: Target endpoint: a declared artifact id or an external locator URI. Required in append mode (or pass artifactId/uri).

artifactId.description: Legacy alias: declared artifact id. With uri, equivalent to from=artifactId, to=uri. Required in update mode.

uri.description: Legacy alias: external locator of the code or test artifact. Required in update mode.

edgeId.description: Explicit edge id (derived from the type and local endpoint(s) when omitted). Required in refresh mode.

kind.description: External locator kind hint (default code/test for implements/verifiedBy).

notes.description: Why this relationship exists; recorded as the edge's notes.

status.description: Edge lifecycle status; new edges default to draft.

createdBy.description: Provenance identity; defaults to a toolchain-recorded edge.
